refunds: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase when the item is unused.
shipping: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.
returns: To return an item, contact support for a prepaid return label and include your order number.
warranty: Products include a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.
cancellation: Orders can be cancelled before they ship by contacting customer support.
account: You can reset your password from the sign-in page using the Forgot password link.
payment: We accept major credit cards and PayPal. Payment is collected when an order ships.
support_hours: Customer support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM local time.
